tasks.title: Sub-weapons become named, catalogued weapons (Missiles Barrage, Homing Missile) instead of slot numbers, and still fire exactly as before
tasks.description: Plan: docs/plans/cmukamteg00e9p52xi2fuoxrx/3-plan.md §Design 1. Write tests/integration/test_rocket_state_launch.gd FIRST as a characterization test of today's RocketState (warhead: 3 missiles at (-16,26),(0,36),(16,26) rotated by the actor; homing: homing_count missiles, ±7 px spread, round-robin targets; CooldownTimer gating) and see it green on the current code. Then add SubWeaponResource (assault/scenes/player/weapons/sub_weapons/sub_weapon.gd: id, display_name, icon, hud_icon; const ALL_IDS = [&"missile_barrage", &"homing_missile"]; static load_id(id)) plus missile_barrage.tres and homing_missile.tres (UID-less or minted UIDs, never hand-typed). RocketState switches from _type:int to _active_id:StringName: _launch() dispatches by id, &"" launches nothing and does not start the cooldown; get_type() -> get_active_id(); select_sub_weapon(id: StringName); get_current_icon() returns hud_icon, or assault/assets/gui/weaponselector/icon_empty_slot.png for &"". _launch_warhead/_launch_homing bodies unchanged. weapon_changed(icon) and EventBus.player_rocket_changed(icon) keep their arity. PlayerMenu's _SUB_WEAPON_NAMES/_SUB_WEAPON_ICONS parallel arrays and RocketState's warhead_icon/homing_icon preloads are replaced by the catalogue (sub column rows unchanged in content and order; its confirm maps row -> ALL_IDS[row]). Q still toggles between the two for now. Add the invariant tests/integration/test_sub_weapon_catalogue.gd. Run updating-project-docs (assault.md weapons section, global.md PlayerMenu).
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: test_rocket_state_launch.gd passes unchanged before and after the refactor, plus a new case: an empty sub id spawns nothing and leaves the timer stopped. test_sub_weapon_catalogue.gd: every ALL_IDS entry has <id>.tres with matching id, display_name, icon and hud_icon; every .tres in the directory is in ALL_IDS; a boundary case proves the check rejects a mismatched id. No positional 0/1 sub-weapon int remains in RocketState or PlayerMenu. test_event_bus.gd, test_signal_emit_arity.gd and test_project_load_integrity.gd green. bash /agent/verify.sh green.

tasks.title: The game remembers a 3 Main + 3 Sub weapon loadout, rejects wrong-type and duplicate weapons, and loads a no-longer-valid saved weapon as an empty slot
tasks.description: Plan: docs/plans/cmukamteg00e9p52xi2fuoxrx/3-plan.md §Design 2 (the full API, rules and file format are specified there, so follow them). New autoload LoadoutState (global/autoloads/loadout_state.gd, registered in project.godot after UpgradeState): EPIC_01's LoadoutManager. Holds ids only: enum Kind {MAIN, SUB}, SLOT_COUNT = 3, enum Reject {OK, BAD_SLOT, UNKNOWN, WRONG_KIND, LOCKED, DUPLICATE, LAST_MAIN}; signals slot_changed(kind: int, slot: int, id: StringName) and active_changed(kind: int, id: StringName); get_slot / get_slots / get_active_index / get_active_id / is_available / check_assign / assign / clear / cycle / set_active_slot. &"" = empty. Duplicates in the same kind rejected; clearing the only occupied Main slot refused; the active index always sits on an occupied slot or is -1; cycle skips empties, wraps, and emits nothing on a no-op. Persists to user://loadout.cfg ([loadout] version, main_0..2, sub_0..2, main_active, sub_active), saved on every successful change. Load validates every slot with the same rules: unknown / wrong-kind / locked / duplicate / wrong-type -> empty + push_warning, never a substitute, never grandfathered (do NOT copy ShipModuleState._load()), and never writes the file. Seed only on a missing file: Main = first up-to-3 UpgradeState.unlocked_ids(), Sub = first up-to-3 SubWeaponResource.ALL_IDS. No consumers yet, so the game plays as before. Add user://loadout.cfg to tests/helpers/save_sandbox.gd PATHS. Unit tests first in tests/unit/test_loadout_state.gd (tree-less Script.new(), like test_ship_module_state.gd). Run updating-project-docs (global.md autoload table, PROJECT.md, CLAUDE.md if appropriate).
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Every LoadoutState case in the plan's Test plan table is a passing test in tests/unit/test_loadout_state.gd, including the boundary cases: slot -1 and 3; main id into SUB and sub id into MAIN; same id into the same slot (true, no signal); cycle with one and with zero occupied slots (no signal); clearing the last main refused, clearing the last sub allowed; seed with 4 mains unlocked keeps the first 3; each load-invalidation rule (unknown, locked, wrong kind, duplicate, non-String, active index 7, active pointing at an invalidated slot) produces an empty slot and never another weapon; load leaves the file untouched. Save file sandboxed. test_signal_emit_arity.gd green. bash /agent/verify.sh green.

tasks.title: In flight, E cycles Main slots 1→2→3 and Q cycles Sub slots 1→2→3, skipping empty slots, with the HUD chips following and every weapon firing exactly as before
tasks.description: Plan: docs/plans/cmukamteg00e9p52xi2fuoxrx/3-plan.md §Design 3. WeaponState reads its active weapon from LoadoutState.get_active_id(MAIN) in _ready, routes cycle_weapon (E) to LoadoutState.cycle(MAIN) and applies LoadoutState.active_changed through one private _switch_to(id) that keeps today's select_weapon side-effects (beam release, sniper cancel, _cooldown = 0, weapon_changed + EventBus.player_weapon_changed emit); _cycle()'s duplicate copy of those side-effects is deleted. On an empty (&"") main nothing fires, weapon_changed(null) is emitted and WeaponChip (assault/scenes/gui/weapon_chip.gd) shows icon_empty_slot.png + "EMPTY". RocketState routes switch_weapon (Q) to LoadoutState.cycle(SUB) and follows active_changed(SUB); special_weapon on an empty sub is a no-op that starts no cooldown. Input map, MovementController and the dash lock unchanged; no mouse wheel, no hotkeys. Interim PlayerMenu behaviour until t5: confirming a list row whose weapon is in the loadout makes that slot active (set_active_slot), otherwise it is a no-op; the row highlight follows LoadoutState's active id. Tests: tests/integration/test_loadout_cycling.gd and tests/integration/test_loadout_weapon_behaviour.gd per the plan's Test plan, on a real player_fighter.tscn (plus one open-space player_ship.tscn case). Snapshot/restore LoadoutState and UpgradeState around live-autoload tests. Run updating-project-docs (assault.md weapon and input sections, open_space.md).
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: E through the real MovementController signal steps WeaponState Main 1→2→3→1 and skips an empty slot; Q steps RocketState over the Sub slots the same way; a press with one occupied slot emits no weapon_changed; the WeaponChip label and mission_hud sub icon follow the active slot; all-empty subs show icon_empty_slot and special_weapon spawns nothing. Behaviour test: default fires an identical bullet count, damage and heat before and after a loadout reorder; switching away from beam releases it, switching away from a charging sniper cancels it, cooldown is 0 after a switch; an empty main fires nothing. Two player scenes instantiated and freed in sequence raise no errors from LoadoutState signals. test_weapon_unlock_sources.gd and test_event_bus.gd green. bash /agent/verify.sh green.

tasks.title: The ship menu shows the current loadout as six prominent frames, MAIN [1][2][3] and SUB [1][2][3], above the full weapon collections, with empty slots drawn as proper empty frames
tasks.description: Plan: docs/plans/cmukamteg00e9p52xi2fuoxrx/3-plan.md §Design 4 and §Design 6. New LoadoutSlotsPanel (global/ui/player_menu/loadout_slots_panel.gd + .tscn, Node2D, built like ShipModulesPanel): six frames using menu_ship_modules_item_frame.png with an Icon child (WeaponModeResource.icon / SubWeaponResource.icon), slot-number and MAIN/SUB header Labels, and a caption for the cursor slot's display_name. Empty = the same frame + icon_empty_slot.png + ShipModulesPanel's grey. States: cursor (yellow), assigning (pink), active-in-flight marker, empty. API: refresh(), set_cursor(kind, slot), set_assigning(kind, slot), get_slot_node(kind, slot); refreshes on LoadoutState.slot_changed / active_changed. Add it to player_menu.tscn at the top of ShipLayout; move MainWeaponFrame / SubWeaponFrame lower and shorten them (list background via a NinePatchRect over weapong_list_frame.png, no stretched pixels), and add MAIN WEAPONS / SUB WEAPONS collection captions; keep the node paths ShipLayout/MainWeaponFrame and SubWeaponFrame. Render-only: navigation and assignment are t5, and t3's interim confirm stays. Visual check: this container has no display, so compose a static mock-up PNG from the real sprite files at the planned positions (a headless Godot script using Image.blend_rect, output under /tmp) and look at it before settling positions. Only if that shows a genuinely missing asset, generate it via the pixel-art-generation skill and scripts/pixellab.sh with its visual check; the expected outcome is no new art. Tests: tests/integration/test_player_menu_loadout.gd (the t4 cases in the plan's Test plan). Run updating-project-docs (global.md PlayerMenu section).
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: LoadoutSlotsPanel exposes exactly 3 MAIN and 3 SUB frames; an empty slot shows icon_empty_slot.png with the grey tint; an assigned slot shows that weapon's menu icon; the active slot shows the active marker; the panel updates on LoadoutState.slot_changed without reopening the menu; ShipLayout/MainWeaponFrame still lists every unlocked main (test_weapon_unlock_sources.gd unchanged and green); test_module_list_lock.gd green; test_project_load_integrity.gd green on the new scene. The final message states whether any PixelLab asset was generated and why, and describes the mock-up that was checked. bash /agent/verify.sh green.

tasks.title: In the ship menu the player picks a loadout slot, then a compatible weapon from the list below; wrong-type and already-equipped weapons can't be picked and say why, and Esc backs out without changes
tasks.description: Plan: docs/plans/cmukamteg00e9p52xi2fuoxrx/3-plan.md §Design 5. PlayerMenu gains a focus model LOADOUT / LISTS / ASSIGNING on top of today's (_cursor_col, _cursor_row) and ModuleList flow. The menu opens on the active Main slot; left/right moves across the six frames, down goes into the lists, up from row 0 goes back to the frames. Confirm on a slot -> ASSIGNING: the frame turns pink, the matching list is rebuilt with a leading 'Empty' row, the cursor lands on the slot's current weapon, and the other list is dimmed. Rows are tinted by LoadoutState.check_assign: DUPLICATE / LAST_MAIN rows are dimmed with ModuleListItem's locked modulate and a reason caption such as 'Equipped in MAIN 2' / 'Keep at least one main weapon'; the slot frame previews the row under the cursor. Confirm on an OK row -> LoadoutState.assign / clear and back to the slot; a rejected row changes nothing and the reason stays shown. Esc cancels and is consumed (no pause menu underneath); Tab in ASSIGNING cancels, a second Tab closes. Confirm in browse mode (LISTS) does nothing, which replaces t3's interim confirm. Cursor and selection are re-applied after every populate / open / close / unlocked_changed rebuild. WeaponFrame / WeaponOption may gain a dimmed-row state; ModuleList behaviour is unchanged. Complexity is large because of the interplay of three focus states with ModuleList, pause and Esc/Tab, so it gets its own plan and review. Tests: extend tests/integration/test_player_menu_loadout.gd with the t5 cases in the plan's Test plan. Run updating-project-docs.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Driving a real player_menu.tscn with InputEventAction: it opens on the active Main slot; confirm on MAIN 2 enters assigning with the frame pink and the cursor in the main list; confirming an OK row updates LoadoutState and returns focus to the slot; a row already in MAIN 1 is dimmed, confirm changes nothing and the reason is shown; no sub row is reachable while assigning a MAIN slot (and vice versa); 'Empty' clears a slot and is refused on the last main; Esc cancels with no change and the pause menu does not open; Tab cancels, then closes and unpauses; unlocked_changed during assigning keeps the cursor on a valid row. test_module_list_lock.gd and test_weapon_unlock_sources.gd unchanged and green; scripts/check-test-leaks.sh clean if any await was added. bash /agent/verify.sh green.
